purpose: Document-level retrieval allow-list. Intentionally empty until a human checks source terms and the exact document URL.
instructions: Add one entry per direct downloadable document, not a search page or website root.
Set collection_permission to allowed only after reviewing applicable terms or obtaining written permission.
Record permission_evidence and terms_checked_on; the pipeline refuses entries without them.
Use exact hostnames in allowed_hosts. Redirects to unapproved hosts are rejected.
Do not add login-protected, paywalled, or commercially licensed content unless the agreement explicitly authorizes this retrieval and intended reuse.
